source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: A [critical wound](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) bypasses saves if the attack used **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:core-rule/devastating-wounds)**. Convert the attack’s final Damage into [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds), including any [Melta](vsdata:weapon-ability/melta) bonus. Set these wounds aside until normal damage is resolved. Apply them to one model and discard any excess. [Feel No Pain](vsdata:core-ability/feel-no-pain) can still apply, including against [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).

effect.mortalWounds: attack's Damage, including Melta and a critical wound's own Damage

detail.feelNoPain: applies, including mortal-only Feel No Pain
